TextLanguage.description: Select the language of the fix settings.
plugin.name: Second Sight Fusion Fix
ResX.description: Width in pixels. Overrides the resolution chosen in the game's Graphics Options. Zero uses the game's choice. Restart required.
ResY.description: Height in pixels. Overrides the resolution chosen in the game's Graphics Options. Zero uses the game's choice. Restart required.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the corrected field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values widen the view. Wider views may reveal through-wall rendering in some locations. The horizontal field of view is limited to 150 degrees.
FPSLimit.description: Limits the frame rate. Applies immediately.
PauseOnFocusLoss.description: In a window mode, the game pauses and goes silent while another window is active. Off keeps it running. Applies immediately.
ConfineCursor.description: Keeps the mouse cursor inside the game window while the game is active, so it can't slip onto another monitor. Applies immediately.
CheckForUpdates.description: Once per start, asks fusionfix.io whether a newer version of the fix is out and tells you in the game. Off makes no network request.
update.availablehub: {name} {version} is available. FusionFixHub opens when you close the game.
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a window, or a borderless window covering the monitor. Needs a restart.
SkipIntro.description: Starts at the title screen, past the logo videos and the copyright screen. Needs a restart.
FMVWidescreenMode.description: Original Aspect shows the movies as the game does, whole inside its centred 4:3 frame with black bars around them. Fill fits the whole movie to the screen, without cutting anything off or stretching it.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto keeps the HUD at the screen edges. A ratio keeps it in a centred box of that shape.
CutsceneBorders.description: Letterbox keeps the game's bars above and below cutscenes; Pillarbox keeps the picture at 4:3 between side bars on wider screens; Both does both and shows the original framing; Off fills the screen. Applies immediately.
